senses.gloss: अ॑-प्लव mf(आ)n. without a ship, AV. xix, 50, 31, &c.
not swimming.
आ-प्लव m. ablution, bathing, Pāṇ.; BhP.; R.
sprinkling with water, L.
आ-प्लाव m. (= आ-प्लव, Pāṇ. iii, 3, 50), submerging, wetting
flood, inundation, L.
अ-प्लव-वत् mfn. without a ship, MBh.
अ-प्लवेश mfn. unable to swim.
अप्-लिङ्ग n. N. of a Liṅga, RTL. 446.
आ-प्लव—व्रतिन् m. one whose duty is to perform the Samāvartana ablution (on returning home after completing his studies), an initiated householder, L.
आ-प्लवन n. immersing, bathing, KātyŚr.; BhP.; MBh.
sprinkling with water, L.
आ-प्लावित mfn. inundated, overflowed, Hariv.; Rājat.; Pañcat.
1. आप्लाव्य mfn. to be used as a bath, serving for bathing, MBh.
bathing (any one), to be washed, bathed
आप्लाव्य n. washing, bathing, Pāṇ.; L.
2. आ-प्लाव्य ind.p. having washed, wetted or sprinkled.
आ-प्लुत mfn. one who has bathed (himself), bathed, MBh.; BhP.
wetted, sprinkled, overflowed, MBh.; Hariv.; Ragh. &c.
ifc. (used fig.) overrun
afflicted, distressed (व्यसना˚)
one who has sprung or jumped near, Hariv.; MBh.
आ-प्लुत m. (= आ-प्लव-व्रतिन्), an initiated householder, L.
आ-प्लुत n. bathing, MBh.
jumping, springing towards, MBh.; Hariv.
आ-प्लुत—व्रतिन् m. = आ-प्लव-व्रतिन्, q.v., L.
आप्लुताङ्ग mf(ई)n. bathed all over, MBh.
आ-प्लुति f. bathing, a bath, L.
आ-प्लुत्य ind.p. having bathed or washed
having jumped up.
आ-प्लुष्ट mfn. a little singed or burnt, Kum. v, 48.
